exposure: Early conception (within 12 months after bariatric surgery)
Time from bariatric surgery to conception
Late conception (after 12 months after bariatric surgery)
cohort: 130 women with previous bariatric surgery and postoperative singleton delivery during 2005-2015 in Lithuania
finding: There were no significant differences in pregnancy complications or neonatal outcomes between women who conceived within 12 months of bariatric surgery and those who conceived later.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in pregnancy complications and neonatal outcomes in women who conceived within the first 12 postoperative months after bariatric surgery and in women who conceived later.
